_README: Long-term (monthly) private rentals — managed manually here. These are NOT PadSplit co-living rooms and are NOT touched by the scraper. Applications go through each unit's TurboTenant link (applyUrl). Add photos to the photos[] array when ready.

units.title: Lake House — 2 Bedroom
units.description:
Bright 2 bed / 1 bath upstairs unit in a duplex-style house in the Norris Lake community — partially furnished, with a brand-new deck & stairs and a backyard to enjoy! The primary bedroom comes with a queen bed, and the second bedroom is a flexible space — furnished with a full bed or left unfurnished, whichever works best for you. The living room is furnished, and the kitchen is a full, basic kitchen with all stainless-steel appliances.

All utilities are included (electric, water, internet, and more), and the security deposit is fully refundable. Laundry is shared with the downstairs unit and located in the garage, with your own designated parking space in the driveway. Small pets under 25 lbs are welcome!

Since it's in the Norris Lake community, a 12+ month lease gets you access to the lake, pool, beach, tennis courts, and parks! Priority is given to long-term leases (12+ months). First month's rent and a refundable security deposit, plus a background and credit check, are required to move in.
units.furnishedNote: Partially furnished — a queen bed in the primary bedroom and a furnished living room. The second bedroom is flexible: furnished with a full bed, or left unfurnished, your choice.
features: Queen bed in the primary bedroom
Flexible second room — furnished or unfurnished, your choice
Norris Lake community: lake, pool, beach, tennis & parks (12+ month lease)

units.title: Lake House — Studio
units.description:
Newly renovated studio in a duplex-style house in the Norris Lake community — fully furnished, private, and move-in ready! You get your own private entry and a separate unit all to yourself: a queen bed, living room furniture, and a fully equipped kitchenette with a fridge, a microwave/oven combo, and a hot plate. Step outside to your own private patio.

All utilities are included (electric, water, internet, and more), and the security deposit is fully refundable. Laundry is shared with the upstairs unit and located in the connected garage, with your own designated parking space. Small pets under 25 lbs are welcome!

Priority is given to long-term leases (12+ months). First month's rent and a refundable security deposit, plus a background and credit check, are required to move in. And since it's in the Norris Lake community, a 12+ month lease gets you access to the lake, pool, beach, tennis courts, and nearby parks!

units.title: Renovated Private Studio
units.description:
Renovated private studio in Decatur — your own private entry and a fully separate unit, unfurnished and ready for you to make it your own. The kitchenette is ready to go, and laundry is all yours too — no sharing with anyone. Utilities and WiFi are included, and this is a long-term lease.

Pets are considered case by case. First month's rent and a security deposit are required to move in.
